title: How Nutella maker Ferrero is spending billions to build a candy empire in America
text:
We went behind the scenes to see how Ferrero, an Italian company is building a confectionery empire in the US, from spending billions on buying iconic American brands, to investing in new factories and an R&D lab, and even creating a new Nutella flavor specifically for Americans.

Editor's note: We made an error by including footage of M&M's and Snickers when mentioning products made with compound chocolate (at 15:04, 15:44, and 15:46). Because M&M's and Snickers use real milk chocolate, we are working to replace the footage with accurate visuals.
